description: For a brand domain (e.g. paypal.com), builds up to 15 look-alike variants (omitted, doubled and swapped letters, 0/1 homoglyphs, hyphen and login additions, other TLDs) and checks which are registered, using the public RDAP directory. Registered means taken, not malicious: each one needs a content check. Unicode homoglyphs (IDN) are not generated. Related tools on this server, for a different need: agent_intel_bytecode_similarity_radar when you need to compare the runtime bytecode of two Ethereum contracts you; agent_intel_domain_authority_credibility when you need Registration facts for a domain from the public RDAP. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

brand.description: Brand domain such as paypal.com (a URL is reduced to its host)
